title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-3463: Medium priority package update for composer
description:
Package names in vendor/composer/installed.json can escape the vendor directory during install and reinstall. (GHSA-c968-33g3-wh7p)

Inline repository HTTP headers, such as API tokens, are written into composer.lock. (GHSA-fm2w-xgf2-f9fh)
